title.en: A little bigger, a little closer

body.zh-Hans: 一起读过五天的信，小信使的身体长大了。它在门口比了比身高，又把今天的见闻放到你手边。
body.en: Five days of reading together, and your little messenger has grown. After measuring up against the doorframe, it leaves today's discoveries beside you.

title.en: A small mark of its own

body.zh-Hans: 二十个陪伴日，小信使有了自己的出门装束。邮局现在可以布置了：在窗台、柜顶、墙上和地上，各放一件带回来的纪念品吧。
body.en: Twenty days together, and your messenger has an outfit of its own. You can now arrange the post office: place a souvenir on the sill, cabinet, wall, and floor.
